theorems.name: Submission.bf_sphereGood_axisFree_measurableSet
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (H : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)), IsCompact A → ∀ (δ : ℝ) (a : Rn N), MeasurableSet {θ : Rn N | θ ∈ H ∧ ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ ¬ ∃ b ∈ A, b ≠ a ∧ dist b a < δ ∧ H.starProjection (b - a) - inner ℝ (H.starProjection (b - a)) θ • θ = 0}
